title: Day 3/100 of Ai trading $10,000 for me on Robinhood Agentic
author: Newrateacc
selftext:
Portfolio: $11,060.42

Today: up $296.64 (up 2.76%). Best day of the three so far. 26 agents live.

Business As Usual, $2,624.80, up $87.94 (up 3.47%), biggest single contributor. This is the one that holds the S&P 500 and only flips into a 3x leveraged S&P 500 fund when NY weather reads normal for the season, read off Kalshi temperature markets. It sold SPY and bought UPRO this morning, so it caught almost all of today's rally levered.

FAANG+ Momentum, $2,545.59, up $120.79 (up 4.98%), the single biggest dollar gain in the book. It rotated out of AMZN and GOOGL into META and NVDA on the daily momentum rerank, then rode the move.

The Silicon Overdrive, $103.50, up $8.94 (up 9.45%), best percent day. Small experimental sleeve targeting 2x the daily return of a US semiconductor index, so a strong chip day shows up loud here.

AI Picks & Shovels, $1,059.71, up $32.09 (up 3.12%). Weekly reweight landed again, sold ANET and DELL, added AMD, more NVDA, more SMCI, and a new TSM position.

Founder Mode, $260.89, up $11.54 (up 4.63%). Sold COIN, HOOD, META, and RKLB, bought CRM and DASH. Rebalances weekly across fifteen founder led companies.

Funny one: NFL Fantasy Agent, down $1.15 (down 6.02%) on an $18 position. It bought yes contracts on Deebo Samuel and CeeDee Lamb hitting reception and yardage thresholds Sunday. Deebo screwing over my fantasy team and Kalshi. 

Pelosi Tracker, High Profile Congress, and CT Scanner all did their usual rotations off fresh disclosures and trial data, small moves either way, nothing dramatic.

Two up days and one neutral day in, net solidly green, still tells you nothing about day 100. Posting every day either way.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: Business As Usual's $87.94 gain raises a specific attribution question: did the Kalshi temperature signal help time the SPY-to-UPRO switch, or was today just a fortunate day to increase leverage? A useful comparison would shuffle the weather labels within each month while preserving the number of UPRO days and the same execution timing. That would test whether the weather timing adds anything beyond the extra exposure. How do you define “normal for the season,” and when is that reading taken?

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: If it’s within 5 degrees of normal it’ll leverage

comments.author: HereForTheCharts
comments.body: that's a pretty interesting setup. especially with 26 agents running different strategies. Curious to see how the performance holds up once you get deeper into the 100 days

comments.author: HereForTheC0mments
comments.body: Is this method worth it with the volume, cost of tokens, amount of time it will take to fill out your taxes, and paying takes on the earnings for short term capital gains?

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body:
1. Theres 0 token cost for us users on Raijin  
2. Robinhood already gives the consolidated tax form that handles it.  
3. The taxes on the earnings are no different than it would be for anything held for under a year

comments.author: dexoyo
comments.body: I’ll actually be surprised if you end up in net profit at the end of 100 days. Agentic trading is great, the only downside is that they don’t have access to all the details in real time as the market tends to shift drastically. It’s usually a hit or miss. But I’ll be happy for you if you do break even or even make some money.

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body: They have a constant feed running of market data and news though, and at least they have way more of an ability to read the markets than me while I’m working 😂 let’s hope for the best

I’m gonna have another chat with it now and let you know what it says.
